item.title: Former Kano commissioner returns official vehicle after leaving office
item.description: A former Kano State Commissioner for Water Resources, Umar Doguwa, has returned his official vehicle after stepping down from the state executive council. Doguwa, who is now the chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Kano, handed the vehicle back to the Secretary to the State Government, Umar Faruk.
